title: Thaya ukat Llamayunakan Dominiopa
intro: Mä dominio uñakiptʼañäni, thayajj mä sapa apnaqiriruw jaysäna, jiskʼa animalanakan arupajj pesaje aptʼasirakïnwa, ukat sapürunjam nayranakan jan uñjkañ chʼamanakajj wali amuyumpiw katjatäpjjäna. Aka jaqix mä munat nayrïr jaqit mä extraordinario reino herencia katuqatayna, jupax elementos ukat jinn ukanakar ch’amampiw apnaqatayna. Ukampis jach’a autoridadax jach’a yant’awinakampiw jutäna — ukat mä qhipa pachax mä muspharkañ uñacht’ayaspawa kunjamas jakawimp jiwañampixa.
clues: Mä jach’a reino katuqawayta mä munat awk taykatxa, jupax mä profeta ukhamarak Allah-an luqtirirakïnwa.
Allah jupax thayarux ch’amanchawayitu, mä phaxs sarañ amtanakar mä alwaw khithawayitu.
Jiskʼa animalanakas jakʼachasiñajat parlapjjerïta, ukat kunjamsa amuyapjje uk uñjasajj mä jukʼa samartʼirïtwa.
Nayajj mä jachʼa ejercito jinn, jaqenaka ukat jamachʼinakaruw pʼeqtʼayäta, taqeniw nayat nayrajj ordenan wakichtʼatäpjjäna.
Jayankir mä apnaqirix mä chʼamäki uka chʼamamp yantʼir jutäna, ukat uka apnaqirin tronopax janïr visitirix mä asientot sartkipanwa tribunalajar apaniyäta.
Nayax sayt’ataw qhiparawayta, mä thujruruw ch’allt’ata, uraqin mä jisk’a uñstawipax ch’allt’añkama — ukat ukapachaw jak’ankirinakax pasawayxatax amuyasipxäna.

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
